timing_boundaries.query_embedding: Wall time for obtaining the query vector; shared by dense/hybrid methods and zero for BM25.
timing_boundaries.reranking: Heading-enriched embedding rerank wall time only.
timing_boundaries.retrieval: Ranking and fusion wall time using precomputed corpus vectors; includes first-stage retrieval for reranking.
